in_sanskrit.name: काव्यथिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who creates or composes poetry.

in_marathi.name: Kavithrika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Poetess or Poetic Creation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavithrika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from 'Kavi' meaning poet and 'Thrika' meaning creation, the name Kavithrika signifies a poetess or a poetic creation.
